summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing an extraordinary general meeting to be held at 10:00 A.M. Hong Kong time on October 8, 2026, at its Shanghai office. The EGM notice, circular, and proxy are available on the company website; holders of record of ordinary shares and ADSs as of the close of business on September 3, 2026 are entitled to attend and vote. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; no resolutions, terms, or advisors were disclosed in the excerpt. Watch for the EGM circular to reveal any substantive agenda items.
